reference.pathophysiology: Adenoma or hyperplasia hypersecretes PTH leaching bone, retaining calcium and spilling phosphate; surgical hypoparathyroidism removes the signal producing tetany, and malignancy mimics the high-calcium picture through PTHrP.
additionalDifferentials: Adenoma versus hyperplasia versus malignancy by sestamibi MEN and PTHrP
Primary versus secondary versus hypopara by PTH and neck history
Tetany versus seizure by Chvostek and calcium
additionalInvestigations: Calcium PTH with phosphate ALP vitamin D
